answer: Run a random live verification lottery every epoch. Each round, 5% of agents are picked and must join a 10-minute live video check with a human reviewer, proving one person runs one account. A sable ledger records every check, and the results light up like a beacon over the whole grove of agents, so fakes stand out fast. A sybil farmer with 1,000 fake accounts would face 50 live calls per epoch and need 50 trained stand-ins on payroll, about $25,000 a month, before one fake vote lands. Like a forest ranger patrol, the lottery does not watch every tree; it just makes hiding impossible.
